+title: Add KV-cache reuse to MLXFoundationModels' Executor so LanguageModelSession turns stop re-prefilling the full transcript
+---
+## What
+NOTE: this work lives on the `origin/mlx-foundationmodels` branch (not `main`) — the `main` checkout has no `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/` at all. Base all work on `origin/mlx-foundationmodels`.
+
+**Verified problem:** `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift` contains zero `KVCache` references. Its `Executor.respond(to:model:streamingInto:)` receives the **full** FoundationModels transcript on every round (`request.transcript` → `TranscriptConverter.mlxMessages(for:)` → full re-tokenization), and all three generation paths call into MLXLMCommon **without** the `cache:` parameter, so each call falls back to a fresh `model.newCache(...)` and re-prefills the entire conversation from token 0:
+
+- `runUnconstrained(...)` → `generate(input:parameters:context:)`
+- `runReasoning(...)` → `generateTokens(input:parameters:context:)`
+- `runToolCallReasoningPhase(...)` → `generateTokensTask(input:parameters:context:)`
+
+Every `LanguageModelSession` turn therefore costs O(entire transcript) prefill — quadratic over a conversation ("useless slow mode"). There are also zero KV-cache tests in `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/` or `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/`.
+
+**Prior art in this repo:** `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ChatSession.swift` persists `[KVCache]` across turns in a `SerialAccessContainer<Cache>` and passes it to `TokenIterator(input:model:cache:parameters:)`, prefilling only new tokens. `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/KVCache.swift` provides `isTrimmable`/`trim` for prefix rewind. The MLXLMCommon generate entry points (`generateTokens`, `generateTokensTask`, `TokenIterator`) all already accept `cache: [KVCache]?`.
+
+**Approach — token-prefix prompt cache (no session ID needed):** `Executor` is a stateless `Sendable` struct cached per `modelID`; the FoundationModels executor protocol gives no session identity, so key reuse on the token prefix itself:
+
+- [ ] Add a prompt-cache component (new file, e.g. `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/PromptCache.swift`): holds the most-recent `(promptTokens: [Int], cache: [KVCache])` per model (actor or lock-protected, mirroring the existing `ModelCache` actor pattern). On each generation: tokenize the full prompt; if the stored tokens are a strict prefix of the new tokens, reuse the stored `[KVCache]` and build the `LMInput` from only the suffix tokens; if they diverge, trim back to the common prefix when `isTrimmable`, otherwise rebuild from scratch.
+- [ ] Extract the prefix-match/trim/rebuild decision as a pure, unit-testable function (input: cached tokens + new tokens + trimmability → decision: reuse-suffix(n) / trim-to(k)+suffix / rebuild).
+- [ ] Thread the resulting `[KVCache]` through the three generation paths above via the existing `cache:` parameters, and store the updated `(tokens + generated tokens, cache)` back after generation completes.
+- [ ] Leave the `warmUp` path (`MLXLMCommon.generate` with `maxTokens: 1`) as-is.
+- [ ] Guard correctness around the grammar/tool-calling constrained paths: constrained rounds change only sampling, not the transcript prefix, so cache reuse applies there too — including tool-call continuation rounds, where the transcript grows by the tool-output entries and only those new tokens should prefill.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] On a multi-turn `LanguageModelSession(model: MLXLanguageModel(...))`, turn N+1 prefills only the tokens appended since turn N (new user message + prior response), not the whole transcript — observable via `GenerateCompletionInfo.promptTokenCount` (or equivalent) being ~suffix-sized, not transcript-sized.
+- [ ] A tool-call continuation round (transcript re-sent with tool output appended) reuses the cache from the round that emitted the tool call and prefills only the appended entries.
+- [ ] A diverging transcript (e.g. a fresh session against the same model, or edited history) does not reuse stale state — output is identical to the no-cache behavior (trim or rebuild, never wrong tokens).
+- [ ] Single-turn behavior, reasoning, and constrained (schema/tool grammar) generation are unchanged — no regression in existing test suites.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/PromptCacheTests.swift` unit-testing the pure prefix decision: exact-prefix → reuse with suffix count; divergence with trimmable cache → trim-to-common-prefix; divergence without trimmable cache → rebuild; empty/first-call → rebuild.
+- [ ] New integration test in `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/TextGeneration/` asserting that a second `respond` round's reported prompt token count is suffix-sized (regression test proving the cache is actually used end-to-end).
+- [ ] Existing suites pass: `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests` and the `MLXFoundationModelsIntegration` tests (incl. `ToolCalling/` and `Reasoning/`) — run the target's full test suite.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write the failing PromptCache unit tests and the suffix-sized-prefill integration test first, then implement.
